summary.text: Selena Torres-Fossett is a Democratic Nevada Assembly member from District 3 who has served since November 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Torres-Fossett assumed office on November 7, 2018, succeeding Nelson Araujo.
For 2025 and 2026 she was assigned to the Commerce and Labor and Ways and Means committees and chairs the Education Committee.
Ballotpedia lists her as chair of the Government Affairs Committee for 2023 and 2024 and as vice chair of that committee for 2021 and 2022.
